summary: Verified Ultimate Gooner (top-50 Goonmaster) feature end-to-end. Backend: all 5 new unit tests pass (test_ultimate_gooner.py) + 31/31 regression tests (test_ranked_perf_rp, test_placement_performance_bonus, test_hotel_map, test_sniper_rework, test_royal_guard_shoot_through, test_jump_broadcast). Backend live check: bumped admin@shooter.com rank_points to 2600, restarted backend, /api/auth/me returned rank_tier=7 with leaderboard_rank=5. Frontend visual verified: PlayerCard header shows 'ULTIMATE GOONER' pill + golden flame badge. Regression: restored rp=0 → tier=0, leaderboard_rank omitted (None) — non-Goonmaster users unaffected.
critical_code_review_comments: TOP50_GOONER_IDS cache + refresh loop in server.py:534-560 are well-scoped and safe (preserves prior cache on DB failure). Refresh interval (30s) sits comfortably in the 5-300s guard-rail.

public_user() attaches leaderboard_rank only when the user_id is in the cache — a Goonmaster who drops out of top-50 is automatically demoted to plain 'GOONMASTER' pill on the next refresh; clean design.
Frontend rankLabelFor + isUltimateGooner helpers are pure functions; PlayerCard.jsx:255-279 wiring is compact and reuses the existing pill styling.
Note: server.py remains ~9200 lines — long-term modularisation still desirable but out of scope.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (visual pill + flame badge rendered; non-Goonmaster confirmed no badge)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily bumped admin rank_points 0→2600 for e2e, then restored to 0. No lingering test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: TOP50_GOONER_IDS is refreshed every 30s; on backend restart the first refresh runs immediately from startup handler. If bumping a user to Goonmaster (>=2100 rp), restart backend OR call refresh_ultimate_gooner_cache() so the cache picks them up before /auth/me returns leaderboard_rank. Feature complete and stable.
